author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: The DshanPi-A1 CM5 is a compact compute module developed by 100ASK and Vanxoak, featuring Rockchip’s RK3576J octa-core processor and a 6 TOPS neural processing unit. Measuring 55 × 40mm, the module supports dual Gigabit Ethernet, multimedia processing, and industrial interfaces for embedded Linux applications. The module follows the original DshanPi-A1 single-board computer, which LinuxGizmos covered […]
title: RK3576 compute module has 6 TOPS NPU and dual GbE carrier board
